# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Zepto, 17 November 2026

**Window:** 18 Oct to 17 Nov 2026. Sources are from the search results only.

## What changed in the last 30 days

**Launches and marketing**
- Zepto landed a brand activation in Seoul Street, and AnimationXpress reports that Anime India is next. Chief brand officer Chandan Mendiratta is quoted, and Zepto has not said which fandom comes next. Fans are queuing in Hyderabad on 14 November. (https://www.animationxpress.com/latest-news/zepto-lands-in-seoul-street-anime-india-is-up-next-the-fans-got-there-years-ago)

**Festive demand**
- Zepto delivered over 14,000 gold and silver coins in one hour during Dhanteras. Platforms including Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and Flipkart Minutes reported strong festive order growth. (https://indiabusinesstrade.in/dhanteras-2026-zepto-delivers-over-14000-gold-and-silver-coins-in-one-hour.htm)

**People and workplace**
- Zepto moved its post-Diwali scheduled holiday from Tuesday to Monday, giving employees an extra day off. Chief HR officer Sneha Arora said the aim was a longer weekend for families. (https://m.economictimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/india-inc-lights-up-diwali-with-longer-weekends-flexible-work-and-extra-pay-for-festive-shifts/articleshow/135618893.cms)
- Reputational risk: a viral video led to coverage that a delivery partner received "cash-like coupons" instead of money as a Diwali bonus, which one commenter called "peanuts in the name of a bonus." A user also criticised startups in the gig economy for weak worker benefits. (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html)
- The same article quotes a social media post claiming a "Zepto valuation 7 billion." This is an unverified claim. (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html)

**Hires and deals**
- No hires or deals within the window were found in the results.

**Background (outside the window)**
- A company profile lists Zepto as a privately held Indian company founded in 2021, with a venture round dated 1 July 2026 for USD 100M and a Series H dated 16 November 2025 for USD 450M. The profile is undated and its data is partly garbled, so verify before citing. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/YT08vmcifB58)

**Excluded:** The "zeptoverse" results (Moneycontrol, Nacionale) concern a particle-physics term and are unrelated to Zepto the company. The Inc42 IPO tracker result shows no Zepto-specific content.

## Open questions

1. How was the Diwali bonus structured for delivery partners, and why were some payouts made as coupons rather than cash?
2. Which fandom or brand is next after Anime India, and what is the planned timing for the Seoul Street and Hyderabad activations?
3. Can you confirm the 2026 funding round and any valuation figures, given that the only valuation reference we found is an unverified social media post?
